name: Akana (10 AP)
body:
The akana are a species of mono-gendered humanoids with an uncanny empathic sense. Though they do not have multiple genders, the akana all generally look feminine by other species’ standards. They are gregarious, charismatic, and quick-witted. They emit pheromones that can bring all sentient creatures to regard them at least in a friendly manner. They are blue-skinned and blooded, hairless, and their skin is smooth and similar in feel to an air-dwelling octopus. They also sport a back-swept bony ridge that helps differentiate one akana from another. Their eyes vary in color but are generally yellow or blue. Akana can procreate with nearly any sentient species or gender as their method of procreation is to take a sample of DNA from another creature and incorporate into their own to form another being. However, any akana born by inter-species relations all come out looking generally like an akana with only minor facial differences based upon the other parent.

Akana are natural diplomats and tend toward bringing cooperation between others. However, they do not shy away from violence if required using their natural psychic platitudes to aid them.

They are also robust and healthy and are able to live upwards of 1,000 years.

Relations: Akana attempt to have good relations with everyone, however, they have difficulty with cultures that focus on conquering and strength.

Alignment and Religion: Akana can be any alignment, some are strident upholders of law and order while others are free-spirited lovers and explorers. Some terrifying akana view their psychic aptitude and natural charisma as a means to dominate and gain power. Akana tend to worship deities of kindness, community, or family.

Adventurers: Akana adventurers can be common. They love exploring, meeting new people, finding new things, and experiencing.

Standard Ancestral Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Akana are naturally charismatic and intelligent. They gain a +2 Charisma and +2 Intelligence. (2 AP)
Size: Akana are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size. (0 AP)
Type: Akana are Humanoids with the akana subtype. (0 AP)
Base Speed: Akana have a base speed of 30 feet. (0 AP)
Languages: Akana begin play speaking akana and common. Akana with high Intelligence scores can choose from any non-secret language. (1 AP)
Defensive Ancestral Traits
Strong Mind: Akana gain a +2 racial bonus on Will saving throws to resist spells and spell-like abilities of the enchantment (charm) and enchantment (compulsion) subschools. In addition, if a member of this race fails such a save, it receives another save 1 round later to prematurely end the effect (assuming the spell or spell-like ability has a duration greater than 1 round). This second save is made at the same DC as the first. If the member of the race has a similar ability from another source (such as a rogue‘s slippery mind class feature), it can only use one of these abilities per round, but can try the other on the next round if the first reroll ability fails. (2 AP)
Feat and Skill Ancestral Traits
Empathetic Diplomat: Akana gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks. In addition, when they use Diplomacy to shift a creature’s attitude, they can do so up to three steps up rather than just two. (3 AP)
Senses Ancestral Traits
Darkvision: Akana can see in the dark up to 60 feet. (2 AP)
Magical Ancestral Traits
Psychic Focus: Akana gain a +2 racial bonus on concentration checks made to cast psychic spells defensively. (1 AP)
Alternative Ancestral Traits
Hypnotic Pheromones: Some akana find ways to leverage their pheromones to more directly influence others. They may cast hypnotism as a psychic spell-like ability once per day using their character level as their caster level. They also add +1 to the DC of all saving throws against spells or effects that inflict the fascinated condition, including the hypnotism from this ability. Additionally, once per day when a creature is making a saving throw against such an effect, the akana can force them to roll twice and take the lower result. The hypnotism spell-like ability has a range of 30 feet and only lasts for 1d4 rounds. An akana can take this trait in place of strong mind and empathic diplomat.
Psychic Diplomat: Some akana develop some psychic abilities to aid their diplomatic skills. Akana with an Intelligence score of 11 or higher gain the following psychic spell-like abilities (the caster level is equal to the user’s character level):
1/day–comprehend languages, detect magic, detect poison, read magic. An akana can take this trait in place of psychic focus.
Psychic Void (+2 AP): Some akana are born with with the terrible ability to absorb life psychically from others. Such akana are considered pariahs of akana society and are either hidden and treated in specialized facilities or are forced to live on the run. Once per day as a standard action, the akana can touch a target. Their eyes turn black and the target takes 1d6 damage plus the akana’s character level and the akana heals by the same amount. Any hit points above their maximum hit points become temporary hit points that last for 1 hour. If this is done during a reproductive act, the target must make a Fortitude save or take three times the amount of damage. A successful save means only normal damage is dealt. An akana can take this trait in place of empathetic diplomat.
Seductive: Akana have an innate charisma that draws others to them. They add a +1 to the saving throw DCs for their spells and spell-like abilities of the enchantment school. In addition, members of this race with a Charisma score of 15 or higher can cast charm person once per day using their character level as their caster level. An akana can take this trait in place of strong mind.
Sociable: Some akana really devote themselves to their ability to bring others to agreement. When they attempt to change a creature’s attitude with a Diplomacy check and fail by 5 or more, they can try to influence the creature a second time even if 24 hours have not passed. An akana can take this trait in place of psychic focus.
